language_origin.basis: New English synthesis of verified historical traces and preserved method versions; no human review claimed.

retrieval_summary: Validate unilateral constraint activation and finite loaded dynamics after geometry or static/KKT screening.
trigger: Validate unilateral constraint activation and finite loaded dynamics after geometry or static/KKT screening.
procedure: For the recorded ideal fixed-payout model, g(q)=ell(q)-L<=0, lambda>=0 and lambda*g=0. Equilibrium uses grad U+Jell.T*lambda-JF.T*F=0.

On a fixed regular taut set, the constrained tangent system is [Kt,JA.T;JA,0][dq;dlambda]=[JF.T*dF;0]. Kt includes geometric and load terms; at switching or degeneracy ordinary derivatives may not apply.

Geometric Jacobian matching does not prove real finite-force response: slackening, unilateral activation and deformation can change the admissible modes. Check actual lengths, tensions, shape and force excitation.
P3 static screening passed before dynamic invalidity. Valid paired ablation supported the tested mechanism only when both responses were stable; invalid ablation left it unresolved.
PHS-2D retained early equilibrium and valid-performance failures before its ten-condition development witness. Time refinement, spatial refinement and physical validation remain separate.
P3 one/two-cell results passed while four-cell response was INVALID at the original time step; do not hide that counterexample or infer a unique spatial-error cause.

bindings.physics: Check task-local model, load, constraints and validity before transfer

applicability: Finite tested equilibria and grids do not prove universal passive stability, hard-rope/soft-constraint equivalence, global nonlinear feasibility or hardware behavior.
escalation: Obtain current scoped evidence and separate action authorization; retain original evaluator and budgets.
